# CompressorSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("CompressorSoundEffect")`

Turns the loud parts down so the whole can be turned up: speech that stays audible under music, an explosion that does not drown the room.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Attack` | `number` | `0.01` | read/write | How quickly it reacts to a loud part, in seconds. |
| `MakeupGain` | `number` | `0` | read/write | What is added back to the whole afterwards, in decibels, 0 to 24. |
| `Ratio` | `number` | `4` | read/write | How much it turns down what is over the threshold: at 4, four decibels over come out as one. |
| `Release` | `number` | `0.1` | read/write | How quickly it lets go after one, in seconds. |
| `Threshold` | `number` | `-20` | read/write | The level above which it turns down, in decibels, -60 to 0. |
